title: Manage non-conformance
goal: The failure has a postmortem record: its impact, what was done at once to contain it, its contributing causes as conditions of the process, corrective and preventive actions each with an owner, and a closed status once those actions are done or dropped.

steps.do: Write who and what the failure reached, how many customers or records it touched, whether money, data or a promise was lost, and whether it is still happening, and open the postmortem record with that impact and a timeline.

Name what stops the bleeding now, pausing the process, reverting the change or telling the affected customer, record each as a mitigation action with an owner, and leave anything that reaches a customer or a regulator to the founder to say.

Work back from the timeline to the conditions of the process or system that let the failure happen, name each as a condition the venture controls and never as a person, and stop at the condition whose removal would have prevented it.

Write one corrective action per contributing cause and one preventive action that keeps the class of failure from returning, each with an owner and a due date, open a handoff for each, and add the matching control point to the process record.
Close the postmortem only when every action is done or dropped with a reason, after a person has reviewed it, and record the lessons another process can reuse.
Record the postmortem as evidence on the handoff that failed, and raise to the strategy lead which preventive action to do first when several are open.

done_criteria.check: Is every contributing cause a condition of the process or system rather than a person, and does every action name one owner and a due date?
